title: The formula published to the tap, and each cut publishing it
objective: bin/devbin formula publish renders packaging/homebrew/devbin.rb at the newest release tag and commits it to the tap matthewsinclair/homebrew-devbin as Formula/devbin.rb; it runs at hv's terminal, since a push from an agent session is refused. Once the tap holds a formula, devbin's release config declares an after: step running formula publish, so each later cut publishes it, and docs/releasing.md stops saying there is no tap.
